cost_pool_basis: ESS payroll split into technology 40%, finance 30%, people 30%; facility/vendor expense to technology; independent audit payroll to assurance. J2 mission and other corporate expense retained centrally. Existing statutory fees credited once, with no journal reposting.
usage_boundary: Monthly synthetic service-unit commitments supplemented by actual generated platform/finance/matter/research events and occupied-position payroll service demand. Industrial people units retain the separate accepted 140/131 population; no combined 2026 headcount claim. Weights are planning consumption assumptions, not observed timesheets or vendor bills.

forecast.boundary: Budget is the selected operating-model input set; revised and synthetic_outturn are separately rebuilt alternatives. Changes apply only to commercial populations starting after June 2027 and an August 2027 planned join. Core cash is requested operating/investing cash before enterprise Treasury, not funded consolidated cash or actual outturn. Sequential attribution order is price, volume, timing, workforce; interactions fall to the later driver.
